title: PRISM-V LabelAudit (human verification ledger)
description: One line per audited item. This ledger is the only independent evidence route C has: without it, 'ground truth' is one machine's opinion used to calibrate another's. It is also the source of gt_confidence, so the validator recomputes precision from here rather than trusting the dataset's own claim.

stratum.description: Pseudo-label precision depends strongly on margin. Precision must therefore be estimated per stratum; a pooled number over an ease-biased sample overstates quality.

human_truths.description: Three-way, mirroring the verifier's own verdicts. Binary labelling fabricates false ground truth exactly in the borderline region under inspection.

kappa.description: Inter-annotator agreement where a subset was double-labelled. Without it the 'human' side of the anchor is itself unmeasured.
